'''Otee Nom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Force Adept]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. She helped train other [[The Force/Legends|Force]] adepts as organized by [[Taleah Novran]] and [[Lony Hertz]]. Nom found inner peace from her [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], and so was never flustered by the odd twists that occurred in life. She preferred to analyze situations before acting in the most practical and efficient manner. The Rodian was honest, however, she sought to minimize hurt even when stating her mind.

Nom was present at the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in 31 BBY.
